source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to NMR spectroscopy (PDF 202).

blocks.text: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy aik taqatwar tareeqa hai jo chemistry, polymer ki sanat, proteins aur qudrati products ke mutale, mahol ki nigrani aur tibb mein wasee taur par use hota hai. Chemistry mein yeh khaas taur par organic compounds pehchanne aur un ki banawat maloom karne mein use hota hai. Proton (1H) NMR aur carbon-13 (13C) NMR do sab se aam tareeqe hain.

blocks.prompt: Organic chemistry mein use hone wali NMR ki do sab se aam qismein batayein.

items: NMR organic compounds aur un ki banawat pehchanta; 1H aur 13C NMR sab se aam.
